description: Angular component for displaying and managing a table of alarms, including features like filtering, sorting, selection, and actions such as acknowledge, clear, and view details.

classes.name: AlarmsDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for managing alarm data, selection, and loading state for the alarms table.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets up configuration, subscriptions, and resize observers.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and observers on component destruction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive form controls and event subscriptions after view initialization.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates the data source when data changes.

methods.name: onEditModeChanged
methods.description: Handles UI changes when edit mode state changes.

methods.name: pageLinkSortDirection
methods.description: Returns the current sort direction for the page link.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Initializes widget configuration, actions, and styles.

methods.name: updateAlarmSource
methods.description: Sets up alarm data keys and columns based on the subscription source.

methods.name: editColumnsToDisplay
methods.description: Opens overlay to edit visible columns.

methods.name: resetPageIndex
methods.description: Resets paginator to first page.

methods.name: editAlarmFilter
methods.description: Opens overlay to edit alarm filter settings.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enters text search filter mode.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Exits text search filter mode.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Fetches and updates alarm data based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: trackByColumnDef
methods.description: Track function for columns.

methods.name: trackByAlarmId
methods.description: Track function for alarms by ID.

methods.name: trackByActionCellDescriptionId
methods.description: Track function for action descriptors.

methods.name: headerStyle
methods.description: Returns style for column headers.

methods.name: rowStyle
methods.description: Returns observable style for a row.

methods.name: cellStyle
methods.description: Returns observable style for a cell.

methods.name: cellContent
methods.description: Returns observable content for a cell.

methods.name: onCellClick
methods.description: Handles cell click events.

methods.name: columnHasCellClick
methods.description: Checks if a column has cell click action.

methods.name: onRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click events.

methods.name: onActionButtonClick
methods.description: Handles action button clicks for alarms.

methods.name: actionEnabled
methods.description: Determines if an action is enabled based on alarm status.

methods.name: openAlarmDetails
methods.description: Opens dialog with alarm details.

methods.name: ackAlarm
methods.description: Acknowledges a specific alarm.

methods.name: ackAlarms
methods.description: Acknowledges selected alarms.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Clears a specific alarm.

methods.name: clearAlarms
methods.description: Clears selected alarms.

methods.name: openAlarmActivity
methods.description: Opens dialog for alarm activity/comments.

methods.name: defaultContent
methods.description: Provides default cell content based on field type.

methods.name: defaultStyle
methods.description: Provides default style for cell based on severity.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached cell and row styles/content.

methods.name: checkAssigneeHasName
methods.description: Checks if alarm assignee has a name or email.

methods.name: getUserDisplayName
methods.description: Gets display name for alarm assignee.

methods.name: getUserInitials
methods.description: Gets initials for alarm assignee.

methods.name: getAvatarBgColor
methods.description: Gets background color for alarm assignee avatar.

methods.name: openAlarmAssigneePanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for assigning alarm.
